scope: Actual bundled shared recovery discovery, routing without mutation, edited-copy identity, source races, cancellation, Save As outcomes and input ownership. No browser layout, listening or universal recovery claim.

results.name: Discovery mounts once in general analysis and runs only from an explicit action
Missing or merely selected source refuses discovery without changing authoring state
Visible discovery compares physical CHR and native Audio without inventing recovery support
Tile route reveals and focuses existing preview without pressing preview or import
Native routes preserve edited bytes and transcription uses the existing edited session
Transcription route without native analysis instructs analysis and does not perform it
Unsupported and invalid binary results explain limits without enabling known routes
All recognition statuses remain literal and distinct in rendered discovery
Selecting another file invalidates results immediately and refuses stale original routes
Busy and failed new reads cannot cause discovery to inspect a retained previous file
Source changes while discovery is pending prevent stale results from publishing
Cancelled earlier discovery cannot overwrite a later completed operation
Duplicate discovery requests do not overlap and mismatched output identity is refused
Evidence exports historical recognition through protected Save As without source bytes
Save As busy, cancel and failure statuses remain accurate without losing current discovery
Late save completion cannot rewrite a newer source status
Discovery controls keep keyboard defaults while the RE mode blocks gameplay input
